title: Battelle biologics lab at Fort Detrick

tellings.quote: Battel's really interesting. I mean, they if if there's any uh group out there that is studying actual biologics, it's probably Battel. Um they run some sort of uh biological materials lab out of Fort Dietrich.

plain: Battelle, a private research company, is said to run a lab for biological materials at Fort Detrick in Maryland, and to be the group most likely studying actual biologics, meaning bodies or tissue of non-human beings. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb suggests this to Michels as his own guess, without naming a source: "if there's any group out there that is studying actual biologics, it's probably Battelle." If true, a contractor would hold the most sensitive part of the secret.
